name: Long-Term Reversal
description: Long-horizon contrarian strategy across the full asset universe: equities, commodities, precious metals, and bonds. Ranks assets by 36-60 month (3-5 year) total return and holds the bottom_n worst performers equal-weighted, exploiting mean reversion from valuation extremes. De Bondt & Thaler-style overreaction anomaly, distinct from short-term mean reversion.
